name: E9 for Materia Mundi: revised magic weapons

magic.name: Earthbreaker
magic.summary: An oversized bludgeon enchanted with elemental Earth energy. Adds 1d6 blunt damage for a light weapon, 2d6 for medium, 3d6 for heavy. Its target's space becomes difficult terrain.

effects.text: Its target's space becomes difficult terrain

magic.name: Firearm
magic.summary: A crossbow-class weapon firing alchemically propelled pellets. Adds 1d6 thunder damage for a light weapon, 2d6 for medium, 3d6 for heavy. Any 6 on a damage die is a critical hit; jams on a natural 1.

effects.text: Built on a crossbow; any 6 on a damage die is a critical hit
Jams on a natural 1 attack roll
Reloading takes an action and an easy Finesse test

magic.name: Flametongue
magic.summary: A blade enchanted with elemental Fire energy. Adds 1d6 fire damage for a light weapon, 2d6 for medium, 3d6 for heavy. Can parry cold attacks.

magic.name: Flying Blade
magic.summary: A light throwing weapon enchanted with elemental Air energy. Adds 1d6 thunder damage for a light weapon, 2d6 for medium, 3d6 for heavy. Returns to your hand each round.

effects.text: Returns to your hand each round

magic.name: Frostbrand
magic.summary: A blade enchanted with elemental Water energy. Adds 1d6 cold damage for a light weapon, 2d6 for medium, 3d6 for heavy. Can parry fire attacks.

magic.name: Keen Blade
magic.summary: A magically sharpened edged weapon. Adds 1d6 extra weapon damage for a light weapon, 2d6 for medium, 3d6 for heavy. Any 6 on a damage die is a critical hit.

effects.text: Any 6 on a damage die is a critical hit

magic.name: Sparkwhip
magic.summary: A silvery chain whip enchanted with elemental Air energy. Adds 1d6 lightning damage for a light weapon, 2d6 for medium, 3d6 for heavy. Attacks against targets in metal armor are easier.

magic.name: Thunderhammer
magic.summary: A bludgeon enhanced with elemental thunder energy. Adds 1d6 thunder damage for a light weapon, 2d6 for medium, 3d6 for heavy.

magic.name: Venom Scythe
magic.summary: A glaive enchanted with elemental Wood energy. Adds 1d6 poison damage for a light weapon, 2d6 for medium, 3d6 for heavy. Its target saves vs. Doom or takes ongoing poison damage.

effects.text: Target saves vs. Doom or takes ongoing poison damage

magic.name: Windbow
magic.summary: A bow enchanted with elemental Air and Wood energy. Adds 1d6 thunder damage for a light weapon, 2d6 for medium, 3d6 for heavy. Range +20 paces.

magic.name: Quiver of Elemental Bolts
magic.summary: Arrows or bolts left in it overnight are charged with its element. Adds 1d6 elemental damage for a light weapon, 2d6 for medium, 3d6 for heavy. (by the size of the bow or crossbow).
